TEST-002: DRC clean against generic_two_layer - 0 errors, 0 warnings (from 5 errors / 13 warnings baseline)
TEST-003: Netlist has zero unconnected pins and zero single-pin nets (VBUS no longer orphaned)
TEST-004: TMP102 VCC/GND/SDA/SCL connected and ADD0 strap separated from the ESP32 GND power-pin miswire
TEST-005: Measured +3V3 within 3.135-3.465 V at ESP32 and TMP102 supply pins under full load
TEST-006: I2C scan finds exactly one device at 0x48; 1 Hz temperature reads for 10 min with no bus errors
TEST-007: Reported temperature within +/-1.0 C of a reference thermometer after 15 min soak
TEST-008: Manufacturability review passes trace/space, drill, annular ring, edge clearance; full fabrication output set produced

constraints: Manufacturer profile generic_two_layer: 2 copper layers, 1.6 mm FR4, min trace/space 0.2 mm, min drill 0.3 mm, min annular ring 0.15 mm, min edge clearance 0.5 mm
Board outline fixed at 110 x 65 mm (35,35 to 145,100); no copper or components outside the outline
USB-C receptacle must sit on a board edge; ESP32-WROOM-32 antenna must overhang the edge with a >=15 x 10 mm copper-free keepout on both layers
TMP102 must be >=20 mm from the LDO and thermally necked from the ground pour
Single-sided SMD assembly, 0402 minimum passive size, <=20 distinct BOM lines
Only one PWR_FLAG per power source net (VBUS, GND); +3V3 must be driven by the regulator power_out pin
USB_B_Micro (J1) must be replaced by a USB-C receptacle; TMP102 ADD0 must not share the ESP32 GND power-pin net
Ambient operating range -10 to +60 C; measurement accuracy budget +/-1.0 C including self-heating
Propose-only stage: no project files, schematic, or layout modified; protected_objects list is empty and must stay untouched
Cost ceiling 15 USD bare board and 20 USD BOM per unit at quantity 10

interfaces.type: USB 2.0 full-speed (USB-C receptacle, D+/D-, 90 Ohm differential)
GPIO strap (EN reset RC, TMP102 ADD0 address strap)

power.input: USB-C VBUS, 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V), 500 mA max sink, CC1/CC2 terminated with 5.1 kOhm pull-downs
power.logic_voltage: 3.3 V from a 5 V-to-3V3 LDO (>=600 mA capability), regulated to +/-5%

requirements.statement: Board shall be powered from a USB-C receptacle VBUS input of 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V).
A 5 V to 3.3 V LDO regulator shall generate the +3V3 logic rail with at least 600 mA continuous output capability.
Total board current draw from VBUS shall not exceed 500 mA so the design stays inside USB default sink limits.
+3V3 rail shall stay within +/-5% (3.135-3.465 V) under all load steps including ESP32 Wi-Fi TX bursts.
LDO input shall have a 10 uF bulk capacitor and the output a 22 uF bulk capacitor, both X5R/X7R ceramic.
ESP32-WROOM-32 3V3 pin shall have a 100 nF decoupling capacitor placed within 3 mm of the pin, plus a 10 uF local bulk capacitor.
TMP102 VCC pin shall have a dedicated 100 nF decoupling capacitor within 2 mm of the pin.

requirements.source: ERC baseline: conflicting power_out flags, power_in not driven
requirements.statement: Exactly one PWR_FLAG shall be attached to VBUS and one to GND; the +3V3 net shall be driven by the regulator output (power_out) so no power_in pin is left undriven.
One I2C bus at 3.3 V logic shall connect ESP32 GPIO21 (SDA) and GPIO22 (SCL) to TMP102 SDA/SCL.
I2C bus shall support standard/fast mode up to 400 kHz.
SDA and SCL shall each have a 4.7 kOhm pull-up resistor to +3V3.
Exactly one I2C target device (TMP102) shall be on the bus, with ADD0 strapped to GND for address 0x48.

requirements.source: baseline netlist GND: J1.4, U1.2, U2.5 miswire
requirements.statement: TMP102 ADD0 shall be tied to GND through its own strap net and shall NOT be merged with the ESP32 GND power pin net miswire present in the baseline netlist.

requirements.source: USB Type-C spec, sink CC termination
requirements.statement: USB-C receptacle shall replace the USB_B_Micro footprint and provide VBUS, GND, D+, D- to the ESP32 USB pins, with CC1/CC2 5.1 kOhm pull-down resistors to advertise a 5 V sink.
USB D+/D- shall be routed as a 90 Ohm differential pair, length-matched within 2.5 mm.
ESP32 EN pin shall be held high by a 10 kOhm pull-up to +3V3 with a 1 uF RC capacitor to GND for power-on reset.
All power and signal nets shall carry explicit net labels (VBUS, +3V3, GND, SDA, SCL, USB_D+, USB_D-, EN) in the schematic.
Board outline shall be 110 x 65 mm, spanning 35,35 to 145,100 in project coordinates.
Stackup shall be 2 copper layers, 1.6 mm FR4 thickness.
USB-C receptacle shall be placed on a board edge with its mating face flush to the outline.
ESP32-WROOM-32 antenna region shall overhang the board edge with a copper- and component-free keepout of at least 15 mm x 10 mm on both layers.
TMP102 shall be placed at least 20 mm from the LDO and its ground pour thermally necked so regulator self-heating does not bias the reading.
All copper and components shall keep at least 0.5 mm clearance from the board edge.
No component courtyards shall overlap and no silkscreen shall overlap exposed pads.
Minimum trace width and minimum copper-to-copper clearance shall be 0.2 mm.
Minimum drill diameter shall be 0.3 mm with a minimum annular ring of 0.15 mm (via 0.3/0.6 mm).
Power traces (VBUS, +3V3) shall be at least 0.5 mm wide to carry 500 mA with under 10 C rise.
A continuous GND pour shall be present on the bottom layer with stitching vias no more than 10 mm apart.
Fabrication outputs (Gerber X2, drill, IPC-356 netlist, BOM, centroid) shall be generated and reviewed against the generic two-layer profile.
All components shall be SMD on the top layer, 0402 or larger passives, for single-side reflow assembly.
Bare-board fabrication cost shall not exceed 15 USD per unit at quantity 10 on the generic two-layer profile.
Total BOM cost shall not exceed 20 USD per unit at quantity 10.
Distinct BOM line items shall be no more than 20 to limit assembly setup cost.
Board shall operate over an ambient range of -10 to +60 C.
End-to-end temperature measurement accuracy shall be within +/-1.0 C over 0 to +50 C ambient, including board self-heating.
LDO junction temperature rise shall be limited so that its case stays under 85 C at maximum load and 60 C ambient.
Local temperature rise at the TMP102 caused by on-board dissipation shall not exceed 2 C above ambient.
ERC shall report 0 errors and 0 warnings, down from the baseline of 10 errors and 8 warnings.
DRC shall report 0 errors and 0 warnings against the generic_two_layer rules, down from the baseline of 5 errors and 13 warnings.
Netlist review shall confirm zero unconnected pins and zero single-pin nets (baseline VBUS has only J1.1).
Netlist review shall confirm TMP102 ADD0 is no longer merged into the ESP32 GND power-pin net and that VCC/GND/SDA/SCL of U2 are connected.
Powered bring-up shall show +3V3 within 3.135-3.465 V at both the ESP32 and TMP102 supply pins.
Firmware I2C scan shall detect exactly one device at address 0x48 and read plausible temperature values at 1 Hz for 10 minutes without bus errors.
Reported temperature shall match a reference thermometer within +/-1.0 C at room ambient after 15 minutes of powered soak.
Manufacturability review shall report no violations of minimum trace/space, drill, annular ring, or edge clearance rules and produce a complete fabrication output set.
Board outline shall be verified as 110 x 65 mm with all copper inside the 35,35-145,100 outline.
Protected objects list shall be confirmed empty and unmodified at hand-back.
